notes.title: Ver 2.13 Update!
notes.content:
This is the first update in a while! We have seen several cases of save data corruption due to errors when auto-saving in dungeons, so we have implemented countermeasures.

[Countermeasures against save failures and save data corruption]
[list]
[*]Auto-save timing in dungeons has been slightly shifted.
(Previously, saving was performed at the same time as dungeon terrain generation, which was considered overloading.)
[*]Automatic backup file generation for saved data has been implemented.
[*]Implemented automatic restoration from backup files in the event of save data corruption.
(When there is no backup file, the corrupted file is deleted.)
[/list]
[Fixes]
[list]
[*]Fixed various anomalies associated with game engine updates.
[/list]

notes.title: ver 2.12 update!
notes.content:
Some fixes have been made. And I added the developer's long-time partner bird "Pooh" to the end credits.

[ Fixes ] 
[list] 
[*]In the last dungeon entry menu, pressing the up and down keys at the time of equipment release would change the difficulty level, but this has been fixed.
[*]When entering the last dungeon for the first time, the first entry message was reopened during the entry staging, but this has been fixed.
[*]Fixed the display text of material objects and mimics being hidden when they are at a distance from the player.
[*]Avoided multiple overlapping sound effects of enemy "meatball" self-destructs.
[*]Fixed multiple overlapping sound effects sounding when cancelling out of various menus.
[*]Fixed in Atelier Pastel where the decoration switch could be operated while opening various menus.
[*]Changed the notation "Gamepad" to "Controller" in the Settings menu (based on the Nintendo Switch version).
[*]Added "-SPECIAL THANKS- POOH (JAVA SPARROW)" to the end credits.
[/list]
Pooh, the Java Sparrow, has made many contributions to this work, including serving as a model for the "Mega Buncho", and a promotional mascot on SNS, and healing for a developer.

He passed away last December at the age of 9. In honor of his contribution, I decided to include his name in the end credits.

Thanks for all these years, Pooh!

notes.title: ver 2.11 update!
notes.content:
The format of the save data will be changed in this update because the previous save data could not be read between different PCs. The format conversion will be done automatically when the game is first started after the update. 
("Now Saving..." will be displayed on the title menu. The conversion will be finished in a moment)

[ Improvement ] 
[list] 
[*]Added "Gamepad vibration on/off" to the settings.
[*]The value now turns yellow when the number of scraps is at its maximum.
[/list] 
[ Adjustment ] 
[list] 
[*]Adjusted the gamepad vibration to be too strong.
[*]Mimics now appear in the last dungeon on Impossible+ difficulty.
[*]Mimic Detector equipment no longer unlocks when entering the last dungeon.
[*]Slightly lowered the life of enemies after the middle level of the initial four-attribute dungeon.
[*]Reduced the scrap cost of warp portal.
[*]Ammo generator can now be equipped in the event dungeon.
[*]Reduced the speed of the Union's top-ranked guided projectiles.
[*]Faster attack cycle for Mega Mushrooms.
[/list] 
[ Fixes ] 
[list] 
[*]Changed save data format.
[*]Fixed a case where multiple sound effects still occurred when simultaneously destroying needle bullets.
[*]The time display flag in the event dungeon is now independent from the settings menu.
[*]Fixed a case where the first message at the entrance of the last dungeon could be canceled.
[*]Fixed a case where the left and right keys could be used to move items when displaying order details in the potion sales menu.
[/list]

notes.title: ver 2.10 update!
notes.content:
Many improvements have been made to fit the Nintendo Switch version!

[ Improvements ]
[list]
[*]Extensive optimization
[*]Gamepad vibration implemented.
[*]The LT (ZL) key on the gamepad can now be used to open the entire map.
[*]Pause menu can now be opened with the ESC key on the keyboard.
[*]The potion sales menu can now be moved by 5 items with the left and right keys.
[*]Separated the save contents of settings from player save data.
[*]In the item box before the last dungeon, equipment that will be removed is marked.
[/list]
[ Adjustments ]
[list]
[*]The formula for calculating the investment cost of material culture has been changed, and the initial investment cost is now much lower.
[*]Changed the altar effect: attack power increase from "Floor only doubled" to "Same effect as STR/DEX potion".
[*]The amount of money required for an altar has been capped.
[*]Lowered the default volume value in settings.
[*]Adjusted the damage of the enemy's needle bullets to the enemy itself.
[*]The distance between players at which the Mega-Uni system resets coordinates has been increased.
[*]The distance between players for Mega Meatball to go into inactivity has been increased.
[*]The number of donations required for the donation bonus has been slightly adjusted.
[*]The release conditions for the "Witch's Taming" achievement can now be viewed from the beginning.
[*]Removed the "Life Reduction" and "Status Abnormalities" altar effects from the last dungeon.
[*]The amount of money found in the last dungeon is now multiplied in the deeper levels.
[/list]
[ Fixes ]
[list]
[*]The word "NEED" at the top of the UI has been changed to "COST".
[*]The game can now be controlled with a gamepad connected afterwards.
[*]Warp bombs now disappear when the boss is defeated.
[*]Fixed the problem of the screen not flashing when defeating a boss.
[*]Avoided multiple sound effects when destroying multiple enemy needles at the same time.
[*]The position of the effect generation when using the altar has been moved up a little.
[*]Fixed a problem where the last dungeon entry menu would let you exit the menu at the same time as your equipment was released.
[*]Other minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Ver 2.04 Update!
notes.content:
The updated contents are as follows. Left stick control now implemented!

[Newly implemented]
・Support for left stick operation on gamepad.

[Adjustments]
・Adjusted the content of the donation bonus.
・Adjusted the scrolling speed of the medicine sales menu.

[Fixes]
・Fixed a problem where the game would go dark and not return when switching from full screen.

notes.title: Ver 2.03 Update!
notes.content:
I made some minor adjustments and fixes. The contents are as follows.

・Excluded material extractors from equipment removal when entering the last dungeon.
・Fixed a bug that prevented the automatic sale of drinks when the amount of money you had was 999,999,999.
・Changed the millisecond count in the play time display from 1/60 to 1/100.
・Moved the life gauge of Wasp-type enemies down a bit.
